description: Resource workload view for a Gantt schedule. Computes per-assignee daily allocation from the tasks and working schedule and renders it as a grid across a rolling multi-week date window, highlighting weekends.

parameters.name: Today
parameters.description: Today's date in the display zone — caps the rolling window at (today − 7 days) and seeds it when no data exists. TmGantt passes the user-zone today; defaults to Today.

parameters.name: DisplayModeChanged
parameters.description: Raised by the Hours | Percent segment of the docked header (arg = the new mode).

parameters.name: Docked
parameters.description: Docked presentation: a card with a header (title, Hours | Percent segment), a continuous date axis over RangeStart..RangeEnd, a legend and a range note. Default false keeps the sparse alternate-view grid.

parameters.name: RangeStart
parameters.description: First day of the docked date axis (the Gantt's range start).

parameters.name: RangeEnd
parameters.description: Last day of the docked date axis (the Gantt's range end).
